research_mode: official MHCLG accredited statistical bulletin only; fail-closed limitations; no parcel score, candidate value or business result

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Release date and England scope
verified_claims: The fire and rescue incident statistics release was published on 22 July 2026 and applies to England.
limitations: Publication timing and national scope do not establish conditions at a specific parcel.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Total incidents attended
verified_claims: Fire and rescue services attended 641,227 incidents in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: An attended-incident total is an England aggregate and cannot be assigned to an address without local incident data.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Annual incident change
verified_claims: The 641,227 incidents were 5.8% more than the previous year's 605,936 incidents.
limitations: Year-on-year change may reflect service demand, recording and operational changes as well as underlying hazards.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Fires attended
verified_claims: Fire and rescue services attended 170,597 fires, 19% more than the previous year's 143,049.
limitations: National fire volume is not a parcel-level probability of fire.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Fire-related fatalities
verified_claims: There were 254 fire-related fatalities in 239 fatal fires, compared with 280 fatalities in 255 fatal fires in the previous year.
limitations: Fatality counts are small, can fluctuate and may be revised after coroners' findings.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Incident type shares
verified_claims: Fires accounted for 27% of incidents, fire false alarms 40%, and non-fire incidents 34% in the year ending March 2026.
limitations: Rounded shares may not sum exactly and describe service workload rather than local risk.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Primary fires
verified_claims: There were 66,383 primary fires, 7.3% more than the previous year but 9.7% fewer than 10 years earlier.
limitations: Primary-fire trends are aggregated across different locations, property types and severities.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Building fires
verified_claims: Fire and rescue services attended 39,859 building fires, 3.1% more than the previous year.
limitations: Building-fire totals combine dwelling and other-building incidents and are not property-specific.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Building fire shares
verified_claims: Building fires represented 6.2% of all incidents, 23% of all fires and 60% of primary fires.
limitations: These proportions describe the national incident mix and must not be converted into a parcel score.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.name: Fire false alarms
verified_claims: Fire and rescue services attended 255,047 fire false alarms, 1.6% more than the previous year.
limitations: False-alarm attendance can be affected by alarm systems, reporting behaviour and service procedures.
